scenario.opening_question: What matters most to us for dinner: variety, price, ambiance, or dietary options?

options.upside: Excellent for strict vegan and gluten-free diets
options.tradeoff: Limited options for meat-eaters or those craving traditional dishes
options.concern: May feel too niche or limited for some tastes

options.name: The Rustic Grill Steakhouse

attrs.menu_variety: steaks, seafood, and a few vegetarian sides

options.name: Mediterranean Mezze House

attrs.menu_variety: mixed meat, seafood, vegetarian, and vegan small plates

options.upside: Wide variety of small plates to share, suits mixed diets
options.tradeoff: Sharing style might not satisfy those wanting full entrees
options.concern: Could take longer to order and eat due to multiple dishes
options.best_for: groups wanting variety and sharing options

options.name: Urban Asian Fusion Eatery

attrs.menu_variety: Asian-inspired dishes with vegetarian and seafood options

options.upside: Affordable with diverse flavors and some vegetarian choices
options.tradeoff: Limited vegan options and some dishes contain nuts or soy
options.concern: Spicy dishes may not suit everyone’s palate
